prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” — the right AI video ad maker depends on your goals. Below are top picks by use-case so you can choose the one that matches your needs.

If you want fast, template-driven social ads (best for marketers/SMBs)
- Canva Video: easiest, tons of templates and formats (square/vertical), good stock library, simple AI-assisted editing. Great for quick social ads.
- Promo.com: built specifically for ads; strong templates and music licensing.

If you want realistic AI presenters / text-to-video with avatars (best for talking-head ads & explainer videos)
- Synthesia: very polished AI presenters and multi-language support; great for professional-looking spokesperson ads.
- HeyGen (Movio/Elai are similar): usually slightly cheaper; good range of avatars and voices.

If you want to turn scripts or articles into videos using stock footage (best for long-form repurposing)
- Pictory or Lumen5: automatically create videos from text, with captions and assets — good for scaled content repurposing.

If you want advanced generative visuals and creative control (best for high-end, novel visuals)
- Runway (Gen-2) or Adobe Firefly Video (beta): capable of generative video effects and creative editing, better for unique visuals than template ads.

If you need voiceovers or natural AI voices
- Murf.ai or Resemble.ai: high-quality synthetic voices you can pair with any video maker.

If you need large-scale, personalized ads at enterprise level
- Idomoo, Rephrase.ai: designed for personalized video at scale (dynamic_name insertion, viewer-specific creative).

Quick recommendations
- For most marketers who want fast, effective ads: start with Canva Video or Promo.com.
- For ads with on-screen AI presenters: use Synthesia.
- For creative, novel video effects: use Runway.

Pricing note: most tools have free tiers or trials; paid plans (for HD export, branding removal, more voices/avatars) typically start ~$10–$30/month for individuals and scale up for teams/enterprise.

If you tell me: platform (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn), budget, desired style (talking head, B-roll + captions, cinematic), and how many ads you need, I’ll recommend 1–2 tools and a quick workflow.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
